summary: Completed comprehensive testing of W1 'Tabel FG Lengkap' and W2 'Ekspor Fleksibel' features. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend features mostly working with one minor issue in Production PO module.

integration_issues.issue: SPP export button with column picker not found in PO detail view
